caption:
In 1960, 132 million Chinese lived in cities. Today 928 million do — more than India and the United States combined.

Watch China open its economy in 1978 and pull away, watch the world turn majority-urban in 2007, and watch India climb to 513 million city dwellers.

📊 See urban population by country from 1960 to 2024 in this animated ranking, in millions. Explore how the world's city dwellers concentrated in a handful of countries, and where Brazil, Indonesia, Nigeria and Russia stand today.

Source: Gapminder, Systema Globalis (concept urban_population, CC BY 4.0). No world total is published for this series, so none is shown.
